signs.Aries: If you have been thinking of making more of a commitment to your loved one, then this could be a great day for making the announcement public. It is also a time when others will want to join in the celebration and congratulate you, so make sure you share it with everyone. There is a natural harmony around that is very fortuitous.
signs.Taurus: If you have been looking for romance and have recently met someone who seems to fit the bill, then make use of the day's auspicious planetary alignment to deepen your relationship. It is a good time to go out somewhere special together where you can talk about all the things that matter to you most and appreciate how much you have in common.
signs.Gemini: Whether you are just about to enter into a relationship, or just about to leave one, the day's planetary aspect indicates that this is a great time for discussion on any important issues. It is also a positive time for communicating in general, especially if you are still looking for the romance of the century. Having conversations with new people is the answer.
signs.Cancer: This may be a time when you feel it is not right for you to settle back in a steady relationship with anyone, as you have been deeply involved for too long now. The astral configuration indicates that for today at least, you are more than happy to flirt from dawn till dusk, and thoroughly enjoy all the attention you receive in the process.
signs.Leo: If you and your loved one need any excuse to have fun, then the lovely day ahead provides the perfect opportunity to have an adventure by going out somewhere exciting. Or you may prefer to create a sumptuous feast and stay in to enjoy feeding each other. Either way, you will have a great time, and will also strengthen you intimate bond.
signs.Virgo: This is a great day for relationships, but not particularly promising in the way of passion. Romance is entirely possible, and if you meet someone special, they may say the most wonderful things that make you feel so good, so wanted, so touched, and so needed. But you may have to wait until the relationship deepens before anything more exciting occurs.
signs.Libra: There is an awful lot of small talk going on today. This you find infuriating but may have to go through the motions of pretending you are entirely riveted by another's conversation before you can get down to discussing the things that really matter. You like to get to the heart of the issue, whereas others need to warm up to it. Be patient!
signs.Scorpio: There is every indication that today you can openly discuss with your partner exactly what you have been feeling about your current relationship. It doesn't matter how much emotion is locked into certain issues. In fact, it will be an advantage to talk about all of these feelings today, as you both have the ability to see things from a more detached perspective, rather than being so caught up in it all.
signs.Sagittarius: There is a certain light touch in the air, thanks to the energy emanating from the planets today. You may have been caught up in all kinds of plans and projects, which meant that the two of you have not been able to spend much time together. Take advantage of the positive atmosphere to go out for a meal, if possible, or somewhere you can both experiment with new things.
signs.Capricorn: This is a perfect day for you to talk seriously to your sweetest love about the future of your relationship. There is a powerful feeling of mutual respect and harmony between you, and this may cause you both to want to take things one step further. If there are any issues that need discussing, then do it today, while path is smoothly paved by the day's planetary aspect.
signs.Aquarius: This is a great day to communicate with new people if you are seeking romance. People in general are in the mood to communicate and to make new friends. A small party could be just the setting where you start talking to that special person who may become a more permanent feature of your life. But primarily it is the quality of the conversation that will make the deepest impression.
signs.Pisces: The planets are aligning to make partnerships more harmonious today. If there has been any friction in the past, then both of you are prepared to talk quietly and calmly about the difficulties you might have shared. There is an emphasis on communication and on getting out and meeting with others. It may be a good time to hold a virtual party, inviting some new faces into your circle.
